added_paragraph: **Bounded rescue requirement, 6 October 2026:** the [ethical-minimum continuation](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM.md#from-moral-favor-to-a-bounded-rescue-requirement) now defends timely serious relief at genuinely minor full-history cost through an explicit comparative requirement principle. [Argument, counterreview and integration](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RESCUE-REQUIREMENT-INTEGRATION.md) preserve the categorical permission rival and distinguish duty from coercion. The source comparison strengthens the demandingness challenge: counting lifetime losses does not establish permission to stop. **Next connection:** justified limits and recurring provision under actual noncompliance, with a genuine authorship claim and unmet severe need both retained. The universal ethical-minimum goal remains active; this is conditional philosophical progress, not universal grounding or new empirical validation.

**From moral favor to bounded duty, 6 October 2026:** [the current ethical minimum](unified-2026-10-05/UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM.md#from-moral-favor-to-a-bounded-rescue-requirement) defends a duty to secure permitted relief of severe ongoing unwanted suffering when a brief replaceable interruption is the only opposing ground. Its additional moral principle and serious permission-based rival remain explicit. Cumulative history constrains the argument but supplies no stopping threshold; a demanding account can already count lifetime losses. The next bridge concerns justified limits and shared provision when actual severe needs persist. The full universal foundation and robust plural latitude remain unfinished.

**Bounded rescue and requiring force, 6 October 2026:** read the [positive argument](RESCUE-REQUIREMENT-ARGUMENT.md), [permission-based challenge](RESCUE-REQUIREMENT-REVIEW.md), [primary-source comparison](RESCUE-REQUIREMENT-SOURCES.md), and [integration and goal audit](RESCUE-REQUIREMENT-INTEGRATION.md). The round defends a narrow duty through an explicit normative bridge, preserves full-history burdens, and rejects treating cumulative accounting as permission to stop. The earlier canonical state has an exact development snapshot. The next comparison holds a real authorship claim, continuing severe need and actual noncompliance together; the universal-minimum goal remains active.

**Moral favor → bounded requiring force, 6 October 2026:** the [serious-relief continuation](UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM.md#from-moral-favor-to-a-bounded-rescue-requirement) defends a limited duty while exposing its additional comparative moral principle. Identified patient experience, efficacy, permitted means, actual costs and the grounds of standing and authorship remain supplied or separately defended. A controller's successful reward does not establish any of them. The argument distinguishes personal direction of a life from categorical permission for every minor refusal, without claiming all permission-based rivals defeated. Source comparison preserves a demanding view that already counts lifetime loss; history accounting alone does not justify moderate demands. Next is legitimate latitude and recurring provision with genuine authorship, actual noncompliance and unmet severe need retained. Conditional causal results, the five foundation conditions and the universal-minimum goal retain their scopes.

Recorded 6 October 2026: [the bounded-rescue primary-source assessment](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RESCUE-REQUIREMENT-SOURCES.md) inspects selected Scanlon manuscript passages and Ashford's 2003 article. It records direct access, exact locators, the temporary PDF hash and limits of historical comparison; no source bytes were imported. The [integration](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RESCUE-REQUIREMENT-INTEGRATION.md) records narrower root verification and the [exact pre-revision canonical snapshot metadata](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM-BEFORE-RESCUE.json). The proposed rescue principle and bilingual formulations are AI-authored research under Ren's continuing goal, not statements attributed to the source authors or new Ren quotations.
